description.value:
In this world nothing can be said to be certain, except victory when you have this gun in your hands.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 4d6, Drop Lowest • Capacity: 10 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes, but at a -2 penalty to Conceal/Reveal Object

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Power Rebuild, Smartgun Link • Mods: None

Special Features: When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 2 rounds in a burst. If there are not 2 rounds left in the magazine, Single Shot expends the entire magazine. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (5d6, Drop Lowest). Every time this weapon is fired, its user suffers 2 HP damage which ignores and does not ablate their armor and cannot reduce the user to less than 1 HP. While the user is in the Seriously or Mortally Wounded Wound State, all ammunition fired by this weapon also functions as Poison Ammunition in addition to its regular damage and other properties.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild, Smartgun Link (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Damage is 4d6, dropping the lowest die. CPR 0.92.4 can't drop dice automatically, so drop them by hand from the damage roll.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
